segments.text: The storm has cut the coast off. The last ferry is overdue. Six people are waiting under the shelter.
This is Mira. She has a map, a radio, and a little daylight left. She needs someone to make a plan with her.
Tell her where to meet. What matters most. And why.
When you return, your promise will still matter. Change the plan, and she must remember the change.
The tide keeps moving. What will you ask her to remember?
